title: Agent DCAT-AP 2.1.1 schema
description: Agent Schema definition based on DCAT-AP 2.1.1 specification

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be Agent

name.description: Property. Model:'dct:description'. This property contains a name of the agent.  This property can be repeated for different  versions of the name (e.g. the name in  different languages)

items.description: Property. Every name in different languages

Type.description: Property. Model:'http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#Concept'. This property refers to a type of the agent that makes the Catalogue or Dataset available
